How To Install First Touch Soccer 2025 Apk Obb Data

In this section you will have to use Zarchiver Android app to use it and extract Obb and Data file for FTS 2025.

How To Extract Data File For FTS 2025

  1. Open installed Zarchiver App and locate downloaded FTS 2025 Data file, now click on the FTS 25 data file in your downloads folder.
  2. From options menu that comes up, click “Extract here”, and the file will be extracted in the current folder you are in.
  3. Now click and hold on the extracted FTS 25 data file, immediately a option menu will come up, then click “Copy”.
  4. Now click on the name of the folder you are currently in at the top of Zarchiver App interface – like mine is “Downloads”.
  5. A drop down menu will appear for you to click “Device storage”.
  6. Next you will click “Android Folder” and proceed.
  7. Then click “Data Folder” and proceed again.
  8. Stay in Data Folder and then click Copy Icon like it is shown in the image below.
  9. Immediately you will see data file is been copied into your Android/data folder.

How To Extract Obb File For FTS 2025 

Carefully follow steps below to extract Obb file for FTS 2025.

  1. Using Installed Zarchiver App, locate and click on the downloaded Obb file FTS 2025 zip or rar file.
  2. From options menu that comes up click “Extract…”.
  3. Then Click on the name of the folder you are already in which is download folder at the top of Zarchiver app interface – like in the image below.
  4. From the drop down menu click “Device storage” and proceed.
  5. Now click on “Android Folder” and proceed again.
  6. Next you click on”Obb Folder” and wait for the next step below.
  7. Finally “click on the extract icon” like in the image below to begin extraction of Obb file into Obb folder.
  8. Finally install FTS 2025 Apk App. Click “Install anyway” when you see a pop-up like in the images below.
